Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:10:1.hebrew: מי שליקט את הפאה - אדם בעלמא שאינו בעל שדה, דאי בבעל שדה לא אמר ר' אליעזר "זכה", דליכא למימר "מיגו דזכי לנפשיה", דאפילו הוא עני, מוזהר הוא שלא ללקט פאה משדה שלו, כדאמר בשחיטת חולין (דף קלא:): "לא תלקט לעני" — להזהיר עני על שלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:10:1.english: One who gleaned the pe'ah - [This refers to] an ordinary person who is not the owner of the field; for if [it were speaking] of the owner of the field, Rabbi Eliezer would not say [that] he acquired [it on the poor person's behalf], since one cannot say "since he could acquire [it] for himself [he can acquire it for another]," as even if he is poor, he is warned not to glean pe'ah from his own field, as it says in [Tractate] Shechitat Chullin (131b): "You shall not glean for the poor" — [this comes] to warn a poor person regarding his own [field].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:11:1.english: From a rich person to a poor person - That it is a rich person who gleaned it for the benefit of the poor person.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:12:1.english: Since [miggo] he can acquire [it] for himself - For if he wanted, he would acquire [it] for himself if he lifted [it] up for himself.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:12:2.english: One miggo - From a poor person to a poor person [i.e., when a poor person acquires for another].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:1.english: And shouldn't the Master say that even [by] a poor person for [another] poor person - the Rabbis say that he does not acquire [it] for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:2.english: For [with regard to] a found item, everyone is [like] poor people toward it - That is to say, everyone is eligible to acquire it, like poor people with pe'ah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:3.hebrew: ותנן - המגביה מציאה לחבירו לא קנה חבירו, ולא אמרינן מגו דאי הוה בעי הוה זכי לנפשיה, זכי נמי לחבריה כי מגבה לה כולה לשם חבירו, דתנן: היה רוכב כו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:3.english: And we learned - One who lifts a found item for his fellow, his fellow has not acquired [it], and we do not say [that] since if he had wanted he could have acquired [it] for himself, he also acquires [it] for his fellow when he lifts it entirely in the name of his fellow — as we learned: "[If one] was riding," etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:4.hebrew: ואמר אני זכיתי בה - קס"ד, אני רוצה לזכות בה עכשיו קאמר, ומודה הוא שמתחילה הגביה לשם חבירו; וקתני זכה בה, אלמא לא קנה חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:14:4.english: And he said: I have acquired it - [Rav Nachman] initially assumed [that] he is saying, "I want to acquire it now," and he concedes that initially he lifted [it] on behalf of his fellow; and [yet the mishna] teaches: "he has acquired it" — thus, his fellow did not acquire [it].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:15:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא מעני לעני מחלוקת - דאמרי רבנן: לא אמרינן "מגו דזכי לנפשיה, זכי נמי לחבריה", אלא היכא דהגביה לדעת שניהם, כגון שנים שהגביהו מציאה, דאמר בה לעיל (בבא מציעא דף ח.) גבי "בזמן שהם מודים חולקים בלא שבועה", דטעמא משום "מגו דזכי בהגבהה זו לנפשיה, זכי נמי לחבריה". אבל "מגו דאי בעי הוה זכי לנפשיה, זכי לחבריה" — לא אמרינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:15:1.english: Granted, if you say [the] dispute [is in a case of] a poor person [gleaning] for a poor person - For the Rabbis say: We do not say, "Since he can acquire [it] for himself, he can also acquire [it] for his fellow," except where he lifted [it] with the intention of [acquiring for] both of them — such as two [people] who lifted a found object, regarding which it states above (Bava Metzia 8a) concerning "when they both acknowledge [each other's claim], they divide [it] without an oath," that the reason is because "since he acquires [a share] with this lifting for himself, he also acquires [a share] for his fellow." However, [the principle of] "since if he wanted he could have acquired [it] for himself, he acquires [it] for his fellow" — we do not say.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:1.hebrew: ואי רשות הרבים הוא קני - בעיר, דדרך לרכוב שם ולא להנהיג, פן יפסקו עוברי דרכים בינו לבין בהמתו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:1.english: And if it is a public domain, he acquires [it] - In a city, where it is customary to ride there and not to lead [an animal], lest passersby come between him and his animal.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:2.hebrew: ואי אדם חשוב הוא - אין דרכו להנהיג בהמה ברגליו, ודרך כבוד לרכוב עליה אף בסמטא שאין בני אדם שם. וכן אשה, שאין בה כח לאחוז הבהמה פן תינתק הימנה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:2.english: And if he is an important person - It is not his way to lead an animal on foot, and [it is] a matter of dignity to ride upon it even in an alleyway where there are no people. And similarly a woman [acquires it], for she does not have the strength to hold the animal lest it break away from her.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:3.hebrew: ואי איניש זילא הוא קני - שדרכו לרכוב לפני כל, אף בלא דוחק, לפי שאינו צנוע. אבל אדם בינוני — כגון שאינו חשוב בעושר ואינו בוש להוליך בהמה ברגליו — אין דרכו לרכוב בסמטא בעיר משום צניעות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:1:3.english: And if he is a base person, he acquires [it] - For it is his way to ride in front of everyone, even without pressing need, because he is not modest. However, an average person — such as one who is not prominent in wealth and is not embarrassed to lead an animal on foot — it is not his way to ride in an alleyway in the city, out of modesty.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:2:1.hebrew: משוך בהמה זו על מנת לקנות כלים שעליה - במקח וממכר, ומוכר לו את הכלים ולא את הבהמה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:2:1.english: Pull this animal in order to acquire [the] vessels that are upon it - [This refers to] buying and selling, where he sells him the vessels, and not the animal.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:3:1.hebrew: לקנות מי קאמר ליה קני - לקנות משמע: אתה התכוין לקנות, אני איני מקנה לך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:3:1.english: [In order] to acquire, did he say to him, "Acquire" - "[In order] to acquire" implies: You intend to acquire [them]; I am not transferring ownership to you.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:4:1.hebrew: מי קני כלים - במשיכה דבהמה עם הבהמה? דמדקא מבעיא לך במוכר כלים בלא בהמה, מכלל דבמוכר שניהם פשיטא לך דמקני בהמה קני כלים משום תורת חצר, דקיימא לן חצרו של אדם קונה לו, ובהמתו כחצרו. והא חצר מהלכת היא, וחצר מהלכת לא שמעינן דתקני, דכי אתרבאי (גיטין דף עז.) מאם המצא תמצא בידו, גגו חצרו וקרפיפו אתרבאי, דלא נייד והוי משתמר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:4:1.english: Does he acquire [the] vessels - Through pulling the animal, along with the animal? For since you raised a dilemma regarding one who sells vessels without [the] animal, [this] implies that when one sells both of them, it is obvious to you that by acquiring [the] animal he acquires [the] vessels by virtue of the law of a courtyard, for we hold [that] a person's courtyard acquires for him, and his animal is like his courtyard. Yet it is a mobile courtyard, and we have not learned that a mobile courtyard acquires; for when [a courtyard] was included (Gittin 77a) from "If it be found, it shall be found in his hand" [Exodus 22:3], [it was] his roof, his courtyard, and his enclosure [that] were included, which do not move and are guarded.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:5:1.hebrew: וכי תימא כשעמדה - לאחר שעקרה ידה ורגלה ונקנית לו הבהמה במשיכה, עמדה ולא הלכה, ונקנו כלים בעמידתה, דקנה לו חצרו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:5:1.english: And if you would say when it stood [still] - After it lifted its foreleg and its hindleg and the animal was acquired by him through pulling, it stood [still] and did not walk, and the vessels were acquired while it was standing, since his courtyard acquired [them] for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:5:2.hebrew: כל שאילו מהלך לא קנה כו' - כלומר, כיון דראויה היא לילך, לאו דומיא דחצר היא, ואין קונה בתורת חצר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:5:2.english: Anything that does not acquire when moving, etc. - That is to say, since it [the animal] is fit to walk, it is not analogous to a courtyard, and [one] does not acquire [through it] under the law of a courtyard.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:6:1.hebrew: והלכתא - האי דפשיטא ליה דכי אמר ליה "קני בהמה וקני כלים", קני:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:6:1.english: And the halakha - [This refers to] that [case] which was obvious to him, that when he says to him, "Acquire the animal and acquire the vessels," he acquires [them].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:6:2.hebrew: בכפותה - היא דפשיטא ליה דדומיא דחצר הוא קני, וכל היכא דאמרינן בגמרא "והאמר רבא כל שאילו מהלך לא קני כו'", מהכא קאמרי ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:6:2.english: When [the animal] is bound - it is [specifically then] that it is obvious to him [Rava] that, similar to a courtyard, it acquires; and wherever we say in the Gemara, "But didn't Rava say: 'Anything that if it walks, it does not acquire,' etc.?" — they say it from here.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:8:1.english: Her basket - A basket on her head, in which she puts her work tools and her spun thread.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:8:2.hebrew: ה"נ דלא הוי גיטא - והאנן תנן במסכת גיטין (דף עז.): זרק לה גיטה לתוך חיקה או לתוך קלתה, הרי זו מגורשת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:8:2.english: Here too, that it is not a [valid] bill of divorce - But didn't we learn in a Mishnah in Tractate Gittin (77a): "[If] he threw her bill of divorce into her lap or into her basket, behold, she is divorced"?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:9:1.hebrew: לא אמר כלום - דאפילו אמרי' המגביה מציאה לחבירו לא קנה חבירו, כיון דיהבה ליה קנייה ממה נפשך. אי קנייה קמא דלא מתכוין להקנות לחבירו, הא יהבה ניהליה במתנה; ואי לא קנייה קמא משום דלא היה מתכוין לקנות, הויא ליה הפקר עד דמטא לידיה דהאי, וקנייה האי במאי דעקרה מידיה דקמא לשם קנייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 9b:9:1.english: He has said nothing - For even if we say [that when] one lifts a found item for his fellow, his fellow has not acquired [it], once he gave it to him, [the rider] acquired it either way: if the first one acquired it, since he did not intend to transfer ownership to his fellow, behold, he gave it to him as a gift; and if the first one did not acquire it, because he did not intend to acquire [it for himself], it was ownerless until it reached the hand of this [rider], and this [rider] acquired it by lifting it from the hand of the first one for the purpose of acquisition.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:14:1.hebrew: ולימא מר מעני לעני מחלוקת - ויחלקו בתופס לב"ח במקום שחב לאחרים, ולא מטעם מגו; דהא רב חסדא, דקאמר כמו רב נחמן בסמוך "המגביה מציאה לחבירו לא קנה חבירו", אית ליה פרק קמא דגיטין (דף יא: ושם) דפליגי בתופס לבעל חוב ולא מטעם מגו — עד דדחי ליה רב פפא: "דלמא במגו פליגי":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:14:1.english: But shouldn't the Master say [that the dispute is even] from a poor person to a poor person - And let them disagree regarding one who seizes [property] for a creditor in a case where it is to the detriment of others, and not because of migo; for Rav Chisda — who says like Rav Nachman shortly below, "One who lifts up a found item for his fellow, his fellow has not acquired [it]" — holds in the first chapter of Gittin (11b and there) that they disagree regarding one who seizes [property] for a creditor and not because of migo, until Rav Pappa refutes him [saying]: "Perhaps they disagree regarding migo."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:3:1.hebrew: משוך בהמה זו וקני כלים שעליה כו' - מבעיא ליה: כיון דמשיכת הבהמה, שהולכת מעצמה, לא שייכא בכלים — לא יקנה הכלים, אבל אם אמר "משוך קופה וקני כלים שבתוכה" — פשיטא ליה דקני. ואם תאמר: תפשוט מברייתא דהמוכר את הספינה (ב"ב דף פה: ושם), דקתני: "משך חמרין ופועלין לתוך ביתו — שניהם יכולין לחזור", אלמא דלא קני פירות במשיכת הבהמה! וי"ל, דהתם לא אמר ליה "קני", לכך לא קני [א"נ, התם כשמשך החמרין ולא משך את החמור]. והא דקתני "בין פסק כו'", ה"ה אפי' פסק ומדד יכולין לחזור, אלא משום דסיפא מפליג בין "פסק עד שלא מדד" ובין "מדד עד שלא פסק" — נקט נמי ברישא האי לישנא. וכן צריך לתרץ בסיפא, דקתני: "פרקן והכניסן לתוך ביתו, פסק עד שלא מדד — אין יכולין לחזור"; ובעי למפשט מינה התם דכלי של מוכר ברשות לוקח לא קני המוכר, שהמקח קיים, אלמא הכלי מתבטל אצל הרשות. משמע: מטעם משיכה אינה קונה, לפי שהוא בכליו של מוכר; וכי משני התם ומוקי לה ששפכן מכליו של מוכר, או במתכלי דתומי — משמע שאם היה בכליו של מוכר לא היה קונה, אף על פי שהכניסן לתוך ביתו, דהיינו משיכה. ואמאי? והא פשיטא לן במשוך קופה זו וקני כלים שבתוכה — קני! אלא התם י"ל: משום דלא אמר ליה "קני", ואינו רוצה שיקנה אלא במשיכת פירות עצמן. ועוד מצינו למימר, דהתם משמע ליה שלא פסק עד אחר המשיכה, ולכך לא קניא במשיכה. וא"ת: אמאי נקט "משוך בהמה זו" ולא נקיט "קני"? אי משום דבקני פשיטא ליה דקני מטעם חצר, אע"פ שהיא מהלכת — א"כ במשוך נמי אמאי מספקא ליה? כיון שהשאילה לו, הרי היא כאילו היא שלו עד לאחר הקנין, ויקנה מטעם חצר! וי"ל: דכשא"ל "משוך" — לא השאיל לו הבהמה לקנות הכלים מטעם חצר, אלא במשיכת הבהמה. אי נמי: אי הוי בעי "קני בהמה וכלים" והוה מהדר ליה דקני — לא היה יכול לידע מזה שבמשיכת הבהמה יקנה הכלים, כי שמא מטעם חצר קני ובכפותה; ולכך איבעי ליה במשוך:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:3:1.english: "Pull this animal and acquire the vessels that are upon it, etc." - [Rabbi Elazar] asks this question because pulling the animal, which walks on its own, is not relevant to the vessels, [so perhaps] he does not acquire the vessels; however, if he said, "Pull a basket and acquire the vessels that are inside it," it is obvious to him that he acquires [them]. And if you say: Resolve [the dilemma] from the baraita in [the chapter] HaMokher Et HaSefinah (Bava Batra 85b and there[abouts]), which teaches: "If one pulled donkey drivers and laborers into his house, both [parties] can retract," which proves that one does not acquire produce through pulling the animal! One can answer that there he did not say to him "Acquire," therefore he does not acquire [them] [alternatively, there [it refers to a case] where he pulled the donkey drivers and did not pull the donkey]. And that which [the baraita] teaches, "whether he fixed [a price], etc.," the same law applies even if he fixed [a price] and measured — they can retract; rather, because the latter clause distinguishes between "he fixed [a price] before he measured" and "he measured before he fixed [a price]," it also used this wording in the first clause. And so too must one explain the latter clause, which teaches: "If he unloaded them and brought them into his house, [if] he fixed [a price] before he measured, they cannot retract"; and [the Gemara] seeks to resolve from it there that a vessel of the seller in the domain of the buyer does not acquire for the seller, for the sale stands — thus [we see] the vessel is nullified relative to the domain. This implies [that] by virtue of pulling [alone] it does not acquire, because it is in the seller's vessels; and when [the Gemara] answers there and establishes it [as referring to a case] where he poured them out of the seller's vessels, or with bundles of garlic, this implies that if it were in the seller's vessels he would not acquire [it], even though he brought them into his house, which is pulling. Yet why? Surely it is obvious to us [that] in [the case of] "Pull this basket and acquire the vessels inside it," he acquires! Rather, there one can say: Because he did not say to him "Acquire," and he only wants him to acquire through pulling the produce itself. And furthermore, we can say that there it is understood to him that he did not fix [the price] until after the pulling, and therefore it is not acquired through pulling. And if you say: Why did [Rabbi Elazar] state "Pull this animal" and not state "Acquire [this animal and the vessels]"? If [it is] because with "Acquire" it is obvious to him that he acquires by virtue of [the law of] a courtyard, even though [the animal] is walking — if so, with "Pull" as well, why is he in doubt? Since [the seller] lent it to him, it is as though it belongs to him until after the acquisition, so let him acquire [the vessels] by virtue of a courtyard! One can answer: When he said to him "Pull," he did not lend him the animal to acquire the vessels by virtue of a courtyard, but rather through pulling the animal. Alternatively: If he had asked [about] "Acquire the animal and the vessels," and [the Gemara] had answered him that he acquires, he would not have been able to know from this that through pulling the animal he acquires the vessels, for perhaps it acquires by virtue of a courtyard and [specifically] when [the animal] is bound; and therefore he asked about "Pull."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:7:1.hebrew: ספינה מינח נייחא ומיא הוא דקא ממטו לה - אע"ג דבפ"ק דקדושין (דף לג:) אמרינן דתלמיד חכם רכוב כמהלך דמי, הכא חצר משום יד אתרבאי, והוה שפיר דומיא דיד, דמינח נייח וממטו לה עם גופיה. וכן בפ"ק דשבת (דף ה: ושם ד"ה אגוז): "אגוז צף ע"ג מים לא הוי הנחה, אגוז בכלי וכלי צף על גבי מים מהו?" — התם משום דדומיא דמלאכת המשכן בעינן, ולא היו מצניעין חפצים בדבר שהיה מתנענע ומתנדנד, אבל גבי קנייה, כיון שהוא דומיא דידו, קני:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:7:1.english: "The boat itself sits idle, and it is the water that moves it" - Even though in the first chapter of Kiddushin (33b) we say that a Torah scholar riding [on an animal] is considered like one who is walking, here a courtyard is derived from [the law of] "hand" [yad], and [the boat] is indeed similar to a hand, which sits idle while they carry it along with his body. And similarly in the first chapter of Shabbat (5b, and there s.v. Egoz): "A nut floating on top of water is not [considered] resting [hanachah]; what is [the law regarding] a nut in a vessel while the vessel is floating on top of water?" — There, [it is] because we require something similar to the labor of the Tabernacle, and they would not store objects in something that was swaying and wobbling; however, regarding acquisition, since it is similar to his hand, he acquires [it].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:8:1.hebrew: ה"נ דלא מגרשה - פרש"י: הא דתנן "זרק לתוך קלתה מגורשת". ותימה: לוקמה בכפותה! ושמא נ"ל דוחק. א"נ, הכא מסברא פריך, כדפריך מספינה, ולא מכח משנה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 9b:8:1.english: "Here too, is she not divorced?" - Rashi explained: [Ravina is asking from] that which we learned in the Mishnah, "If he threw [a bill of divorce] into her basket, she is divorced." And this is puzzling: let [the Gemara] establish [that Mishnah] as referring to [a woman who is] bound! Perhaps it seems to me [that such an explanation would be] forced. Alternatively, here [Ravina] objects from reasoning, just as he objects from [the case of] a boat, and not on the strength of a Mishnah.
